{{Quote|The Tusken Raiders have built no permanent shelters, although I followed them to a traditional encampment among the rocky badlands in the Jundland Wastes, in an area called the Needles. These caves and fissures in the hot rock are sheltering places for Tusken clans during the sandstorm season.|[[Mammon Hoole]]|<ref name="TISWU" />}}
The '''sandstorm season''', also known as the '''sandwhirl season''', was an [[Local year|annual]] [[storm season]] on the [[Desert/Legends|desert]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].<ref name="TISWU" /> It was a dangerous<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|III|268&ndash;269|Tusken Raider}}</ref> [[Season/Legends|season]] characterized by furious winds<ref name="ICC">''[[Star Wars: Incredible Cross-Sections]]''</ref> and titanic [[Sandstorm/Legends|sandstorms]] that altered the landscape and erased landmarks.<ref name="TISWU" /> The sandstorm season was preceded by a [[growing season]].<ref name="SP" />

Once each year, the [[Jawa/Legends|Jawas]] held a [[swap meet]] in the [[Dune Sea/Legends|Dune Sea]], the [[Great Swap Meet]], just before the start of the sandstorm season.<ref name="TISWU" />
